description: tl-platform's default (weekly, grouped, digests pinned, auto-merge once a person approves and the required checks pass), plus OpenTofu, its providers and the landing-zone module. A provider bump changes a root, so it is planned and needs /apply like any other change.

customManagers.description: The OpenTofu version every root's plan and apply install.

packageRules.description: OpenTofu itself and the providers of every root, in one PR.

The tl-platform modules, pinned by <module>/vX.Y.Z. Renovate shows a new release on the Dependency Dashboard and opens the PR only when a devops member ticks it, because a module bump rolls out ring by ring (.claude/rules/coding-hcl.md). Never a major, which needs caller changes.
